subject: ACK Liger micro PASS; authorize one matched whole-model nonmutating A/B after persistence
body: ACK Liger 0.8.4 micro-parity PASS. First persist the exact micro receipt + decision to Draft PR #82, push, and remote-read back the new head. Then, if GPU is still FREE, Lane B is authorized for exactly one matched whole-model NONMUTATING Liger A/B using the already-accepted runtime subject: same base, rows4096-4103, seed, variable-shape batching, FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv, no optimizer, no model-weight mutation, no training-venv install. Control=no Liger. Candidate=apply the already micro-qualified Liger Qwen3.5 patches from the pinned scratch source/wheel only. Persist exact loss, per-microbatch loss, all trainable-gradient finite/parity evidence, backward elapsed time, peak allocated/reserved VRAM, runtime/package provenance, and exact no-weight-change proof. Promotion threshold remains prospective: candidate must preserve loss semantics (loss relative error <=0.005), all-gradient cosine >=0.995 and relative-L2 <=0.02 or tighter if observed, AND deliver >=5% matched whole-model speedup OR >=10% peak-memory reduction with no material regression. If it misses those benefit thresholds, reject Liger and freeze acceleration work. If it passes, publish/release and PROPOSE one bounded BNB8 weight-changing qualification; do not run that mutation without a new ACK. Separate disposition: Lane A FLA causal-conv scratch idea is CLOSED as duplicate of already-tested fla_triton_full. Persisted whole-model conv A/B showed candidate 158.684s vs control 156.827s (1.184% slower), identical memory, so no FLA-conv retest. Current best known baseline remains FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv + nonpaged BNB8.
